reviews.author: Shaik Farzana
reviews.text:
I visited Dr. Sneha for treatment of melasma on my nose. During my first consultation, she recommended a chemical peel. However, even after several days, my skin did not start peeling, and there was no noticeable improvement.

When I returned and informed her about the lack of results, she recommended a Cosmelan peel and assured me that it would provide 100% results. I underwent the treatment, but once again, I saw no improvement.

On my next visit, she prescribed a serum and told me that it would completely remove the pigmentation. She also assured me that if there was still no improvement, she would provide laser treatment and a peel free of charge.

After about one and a half months, I visited the hospital again because there was still no change. This time, she wanted to repeat the Cosmelan treatment. I politely reminded her that she had previously mentioned laser treatment and requested that we proceed with that instead, as the previous Cosmelan treatment had not worked for me.

Instead of discussing my concerns professionally, Dr. Sneha began raising her voice and accused me of creating a "nuisance" during my previous visit. I remained calm and simply asked why she was speaking to me in that manner and whether this was how patients were treated. Her response was, "Yes, this is how I speak. If you want treatment, take it; otherwise, go somewhere else."

Because of the loud conversation, other patients noticed what was happening. Ms. Atthota Kavitha then came into the consultation room and, instead of trying to resolve the issue, also raised her voice and supported Dr. Sneha. She told me that this is how things work and that if I wasn't satisfied, I could go to another hospital. She also mentioned that people spend lakhs on such treatments, which made me feel that patients who cannot afford expensive treatments are not valued equally.

I found the behavior of both Dr. Sneha and Ms. Atthota Kavitha to be unprofessional, disrespectful, and insensitive. As a patient, I expected to be treated with courtesy and to have my concerns addressed respectfully, regardless of the treatment cost.

In my experience, there was a greater focus on recommending expensive treatments and medications rather than identifying the root cause of my condition. My overall experience was disappointing, both in terms of the treatment outcome and the way I was treated.

I am sharing my experience so that others can make an informed decision before choosing this hospital.

reviews.author: md shareef Shaik
reviews.text:
This is a review of my personal experience at this hospital.My sister consulted here for a skin issue (a dark spot) on her nose. During the initial consultation with my father and sister, Sneha stated she would perform a peel treatment and prescribe medicines, promising a 100% cure within 2 months.

After 2 months, there was only a 50% improvement. When my sister and I returned to ask why the issue was not fully resolved, the doctor changed her stance. She claimed results depend on skin types and it would only ever cure 70–80%—something she completely failed to mention during the first visit. When I questioned her changing commitments, she resorted to excuses. Ultimately, she prescribed another cream and explicitly promised that if there was no change in a month, she would perform a free peel and laser treatment.

After one and a half months, my sister returned because the dark spot was still visible. When my sister questioned her about the promised laser treatment, Sneha literally began shouting at her so loudly that patients and staff outside could clearly hear. Instead of honoring her word, she aggressively accused my sister and me of "creating a nuisance" during our previous visit, when we had simply asked polite questions about her prior commitment.

Hearing the loud shouting, the senior doctor, Dr. Kavitha, came out of her cabin. Instead of de-escalating the situation, Dr. Kavitha took Sneha's side, falsely claiming they had explained everything from the start. She even dismissively added that people spend lakhs without seeing complete results.

Is this an acceptable way to treat and speak to patients?
Medical professionals must realize they are not treating people for free; they charge for every single penny of the treatment. Having big degrees does not make someone a good doctor if they do not know how to speak to patients with basic decency and respect. I strongly advise everyone to read this and think twice before consulting Sneha or Dr. Kavitha at this hospital.

reviews.author: SAI BHAVANA MANNAVA
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing and disrespectful experience with Dr. K. Kavitha and her clinic staff.

Before visiting, I called the receptionist to check if there was a token system or online booking. I was told strictly that I must come in person. Surprisingly, in today’s digital era, the clinic does not even support basic online payments, which itself is inconvenient.

After reaching, I paid ₹500 and was given token number 67, while token 30 was supposedly going on. I was told my turn would come around 4:00 PM. However, what followed was completely unprofessional—multiple patients who arrived after me, took tokens in front of me, and paid in front of me were sent inside before me. This happened repeatedly (at least 5–6 times).

When I questioned the receptionist, she responded rudely and dismissively. Even after waiting patiently and asking multiple times, I kept being told the same token number was going on, which clearly did not match what was happening in reality.

The situation escalated when my mother questioned this unfair system, and the receptionist spoke in an extremely disrespectful tone. Eventually, we were called in, but instead of resolving the issue, Dr. K. Kavitha herself behaved in a highly unprofessional, raised her tone towards an patient which is such a rude manner. She raised her voice, showed no empathy, and made statements like “If you want treatment, talk, otherwise leave" and many more other statements like this..

At no point did we feel respected or heard. As paying patients, basic courtesy and transparency are expected. Instead, we were treated with arrogance and disregard.

I chose to walk out without consultation because I did not feel comfortable or safe continuing under such behavior. A doctor is expected to maintain professionalism, patience, and respect—none of which were demonstrated here.

After coming home, I noticed several other reviews mentioning similar issues, which is concerning and indicates a pattern.

I strongly suggest the clinic improves:
1. Patient handling and Respectful communication
2. Transparency in token management
3. Basic courtesy and professionalism

This was not just a bad experience—it was unacceptable.

reviews.author: pavani reddy
reviews.text:
I have been a loyal patient of Dr. Kavitha garu for over 20 years. My family, relatives, and many friends have visited this clinic solely based on our recommendation. That trust was built on Dr. Kavitha garu’s unwavering ethics, professionalism, discretion, and genuine patient care. She represents integrity in the medical field.

Unfortunately, my experience with Dr. Sneha was deeply concerning.

During my laser procedure, there was visible distraction and casual behavior that did not reflect the seriousness required in a medical setting. Social media content was being viewed and discussed in the treatment area during the procedure, which felt highly inappropriate.

In addition, Dr. Sneha and her trainees openly discussed another patient who had come for consultation and chosen not to proceed with treatment. Sarcastic remarks were made about that patient asking detailed questions and leaving. Hearing commentary about another patient while undergoing my own procedure was uncomfortable and raised serious concerns about confidentiality and professional conduct.

More concerning, the laser procedure resulted in a burn to my skin. This outcome has caused distress and raises significant concerns regarding technique, attention, and patient safety.

A medical clinic must prioritize focus, discretion, and safety at all times. The environment I experienced did not reflect the high ethical standards this clinic was once known for.

Dr. Kavitha garu built this institution on decades of trust and integrity. It is disappointing to see that standard compromised.
